import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('file:claims.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
q='''select c.claim_id,c.policy_id,c.claim_type,c.section,c.incident_date,c.notified_date,c.crime_reference,c.claimed_amount_gbp,c.excess_gbp,c.reserve_gbp,c.policy_status,c.evidence_status,c.evidence_notes,c.proposed_settlement_gbp,c.approved_by,c.decision_date,c.decline_clause_id,c.decision_notes,c.claim_status,c.handler_id,
p.product,p.first_incepted,p.cover_start,p.cover_end,p.policy_status,p.vehicle_value_gbp,p.buildings_sum_insured_gbp,p.contents_sum_insured_gbp,p.single_article_limit_gbp,p.specified_items,p.excess_standard_gbp,p.excess_escape_of_water_gbp,p.excess_compulsory_gbp,p.excess_voluntary_gbp,p.excess_windscreen_gbp,p.optional_covers,p.exclusions,p.insured_risks,c.description from claims c join policies p using(policy_id) order by 1'''
cur=c.execute(q);cols=[d[0] for d in cur.description]
for r in cur:
    print('|'.join(f'{k}={v}' for k,v in zip(cols,r) if v not in (None,'')))
    print()
E"}
